previous_results_seen: PR259 demonstrated that an IID source-population average camera q can be valid for the population and invalid for individual physical cameras; its source-free 96 paired comparisons and synthetic results were already exposed. This new frozen route keeps site identity but investigates temporal transport across rising/falling photoperiod branches.
ecological_question: At SAME physical camera site, can a perfectly calibrated q averaged over rising and falling photoperiod branches be used to infer new-independent-site clock-vs-solar-vs-season forecast majority when actual camera sensitivity changes by branch?

calibration_design.method_site_only_source: For each of 16 heldout sites ×6 civil 4h blocks, draw each independent reference opportunity's branch rising/falling by P=1/2 and then Bernoulli(q_site,branch,block); number triggered successes is EXACT Binomial(n_siteonly, mean(q_rise,q_fall)). CP simultaneous interval over 96 source cells has VALID coverage for branch-AVERAGE q, but it cannot cover actual branch-specific source target if q changes seasonally.
calibration_design.method_site_x_branch_source: For each actual heldout physical site ×2 season branches ×6 civil 4h blocks, independently label known true passages and focal camera successes; exact 192-cell joint CP (alpha_q=.025) targets the correct station×branch×civil block q
calibration_design.site_majority_test: Physical heldout sites n=16. For each site and fixed trained pair A/B, lower bound the score gap over the independently calibrated q confidence region using SAME original 96 civil bins and shared q for both models. Count strict-positive robust physical site lower bounds, exact right-tail Binom(16,0.5); require >=14/16 after 4-way Bonferroni.
calibration_design.cross_date_bound: Since true q_station,branch,block is shared among all 41 days of each branch, summing per-date sharp normalizer bounds is a CONSERVATIVE OUTER interval, NOT the sharp feasible 82-day joint q limit.
calibration_design.no_oracle_gating: True known synthetic q in confidence intervals is saved only for debugging, never used to decide pass/HOLD/site sign test. Source q interval miscoverage is already paid by alpha_q.

output_contract.all_case_counts: 2 camera q seasonal worlds ×3 animal time truths ×2 event n ×2 reference budgets ×4 model pairs =96 paired comparisons, 192 arms.

hard_gates: Preserve exact 41 astronomy-mirror pairs, 82 original civil dates, same 96 15-minute civil response bins, original five frozen forecast families, and 16 separate training/16 heldout PHYSICAL camera sites.
Every method's external reference costs match by independent known TRUE opportunities: 16*6*n_site_only =16*2*6*n_site_branch = nominal total budget.
IID branch-mixture reference successes are genuinely Binomial at source branch-average q, even when two branches' per-camera q differ.

Source site-only branch-average CP interval NEVER qualifies as a clock-bin-specific per-branch detector confidence set if branch q heterogeneous; all such 48 paired cases predeclared HOLD, regardless of positive forecast winner.

Qualified station×branch CP covers 192 source q cells jointly with alpha=.025 under binomial independent reference opportunities; carry familywise error alongside exact physical-site sign test four-pair alpha=.025.
All 16 heldout site q source reference data independent of animal events, and q truth stationary within each branch across dates; no event-driven selection of source reference sensors.
Source q oracle coverage audit must NEVER be an operational admission gate or influence significance.
When site 16 q denominator intervals have zero lower support return HOLD, no pseudocount.

Compare two frozen training-estimated event-time model predictors via the SAME unknown physical detector q in both normalizers and same original clock-bin event counts; no transform-specific outcome bins.
The per-date extrema summed across dates are conservative OUTER rather than SHARP for q shared over 41 dates in a season branch.
No inference on actual causal circadian entrainment, individual animal behavioral state, mean per-site prediction advantage or true photoperiod memory.
